card.name: New-user prompts on websites
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words right after a newcomer prompt such as "New to X?" or "Not a member yet?" on web pages. Also weaker on text about beginners or no prior experience.

modes.label: Newcomer sign-up prompts
modes.description: The question mark or following words after "New to ...?" or "Not a member yet?" on forum pages.

modes.label: Beginner or experience wording
modes.description: Words in sentences about newcomers or prior experience not being needed.
modes.example: Previous<< GIS>> experience, while helpful, is not required

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning beginner or novice, such as "newbie" and "inexperienced", so the model is less likely to write them next.
card.plain: It fires after "New to this site?" style prompts and holds back words like beginner or newbie.
